item.title: ‘Uncanny Valley’: Iran War in the AI Era, Prediction Market Ethics, and Paramount Beats Netflix
item.description: In this episode, our hosts unpack the ongoing conflict in the Middle East, particularly as the AI industry has been entrenching itself with the Department of Defense.

item.title: OpenAI Had Banned Military Use. The Pentagon Tested Its Models Through Microsoft Anyway
item.description: Sources allege the Defense Department experimented with Microsoft’s version of OpenAI technology before the ChatGPT-maker lifted its prohibition on military applications.

item.title: ByteDance’s AI Ambitions Are Being Hampered by Compute Restraints and Copyright Concerns
item.description: ByteDance’s new Seedance 2.0 AI video model seemed unstoppable—until heavy demand strained the company’s compute capacity and copyright complaints began piling up.

item.title: Grammarly Is Offering ‘Expert’ AI Reviews From Your Favorite Authors—Dead or Alive
item.description: The tool, offered by the recently-rebranded company Superhuman, gives feedback based on the work of famous dead and living writers—without their permission.

item.title: Big Tech Signs White House Data Center Pledge With Good Optics and Little Substance
item.description: “Data centers … they need some PR help,”President Donald Trump said at the event.

item.title: What AI Models for War Actually Look Like
item.description: While companies like Anthropic debate limits on military uses of AI, Smack Technologies is training models to plan battlefield operations.

item.title: What Is That Mysterious Metallic Device US Chief Design Officer Joe Gebbia Is Using?
item.description: Gebbia was reportedly spotted at a San Francisco coffee shop using an unidentified pair of earbuds with a circular disc that looks similar to the device seen in a recent OpenAI hoax ad.

item.title: Summon This AI Agent by Speaking Its Wake Word Mid-Phone Call
item.description: Deutsche Telekom, the German cell provider—which holds a majority stake in T-Mobile—is partnering with ElevenLabs to enable an AI assistant on all of its network’s calls in Germany. No app required.

item.title: The Data Centers Have Arrived at the Edge of the Arctic Circle
item.description: As AI labs gorge themselves on compute, data center operators have headed north in search of cheap and plentiful energy.

item.title: Anthropic Hits Back After US Military Labels It a ‘Supply Chain Risk’
item.description: Anthropic says it would be “legally unsound” for the Pentagon to blacklist its technology after talks over military use of its artificial intelligence models broke down.
